pairs.why: A is chunkier, with a taller, softer cover and a rounder toy-like build that matches the bold, soft shapes of the real cards; B is slimmer and shinier, more like real chrome.
Both are close, but A is a bigger, softer-lit, chunkier shape with gentler highlights, while B's metal is a bit more contrasty and realistic.
A has the thick, rounded, simplified build of the real cards; B is thinner and longer, and its glossier chrome reads as a real product shot.
A's large, soft, evenly lit body is slightly closer to the smooth finish of the real cards than B's sharper metallic highlights.
A has smoother, warmer surfaces and simpler sole shapes, like the smooth glossy-but-soft real cards; B leans toward matte, detailed real leather.
B's smooth, softly lit toy leather with a light sole matches the real finish; A's darker welt and fussier stitching make it look slightly more realistic.
A's simpler, smoother rounded boots fit the real cards; B's filled star patches and dark soles add slightly more realistic leather detail.
B is the smoother, simpler variant whose clean surfaces match the real cards; A has more leather-like texture and a darker, more realistic sole.
